text_blocks.snippet: Pi Network is a cryptocurrency project that allows users to mine Pi coins using a mobile app, without the energy-intensive processes of traditional mining. It's designed to be accessible and user-friendly, with a focus on building a community and ecosystem around the cryptocurrency.

list.title: Mobile-first cryptocurrency:
list.snippet: Pi Network aims to be easily accessible to anyone with a smartphone.

list.title: Community-driven:
list.snippet: It emphasizes building a large and active user base (Pioneers) who contribute to the network's growth and development.

list.title: Mining process:
list.snippet: Users can mine Pi by simply tapping a button on the app once a day, which initiates a 24-hour mining session.

list.title: Social element:
list.snippet: Pi Network encourages users to interact with each other, build "Security Circles" for enhanced trust, and participate in community discussions.

list.title: Enclosed Mainnet:
list.snippet: Pi Network is currently in the "enclosed" mainnet phase, meaning that Pi coins are not yet freely tradable on major exchanges.
Pioneer: The basic user role, responsible for mining Pi.
Contributor: Users who contribute to the network's security by building Security Circles.
Ambassador: Users who invite new members to the network.
Node: Users who run the Pi node software to validate transactions.
Security Circles: A system for establishing trust within the network.

list.title: Lack of tradability:
list.snippet: Pi coins are not yet freely tradable on major exchanges, which raises questions about their value.

list.title: Mainnet delays:
list.snippet: The mainnet launch has been delayed, and the enclosed mainnet phase has raised concerns about the project's timeline.

list.title: Data collection:
list.snippet: The Pi Network app collects user data, including personal information and app usage data.

list.title: KYC requirements:
list.snippet: Users need to provide KYC (Know Your Customer) information, including government-issued identification, before they can trade Pi on future apps.

text_blocks.snippet: In short, Pi Network is a project with ambitious goals of creating a widely accessible and community-driven cryptocurrency. However, it also faces challenges, including delayed mainnet launch, questions about tradability, and data privacy concerns.
